description.zh: 实例ID。多个ID用英文逗号分隔，最大不超过100个。
description.en: The ID of the instance. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified.
The region in which the instance resides.

description.zh:
续费状态，取值：

AutoRenewal：自动续费

ManualRenewal：手动续费

NotRenewal：不续费
description.en:
The method that is used to renew the instance. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: automatically renews the instance.

ManualRenewal: manually renews the instance.

NotRenewal: does not renew the instance.

description.zh:
付费类型

Subscription：预付费

PayAsYouGo：后付费
description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Subscription: the subscription billing method.

PayAsYouGo: the pay-as-you-go billing method.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi release-instance --product-code ecs --subscription-type PayAsYouGo --instance-ids rm-xxxxxxxxxxxx --renew-status AutoRenewal --biz-region cn-hangzhou --product-type ecs --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi ReleaseInstance --region cn-hangzhou --SubscriptionType PayAsYouGo --ProductCode ecs --ProductType ecs --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceIds 'rm-xxxxxxxxxxxx' --RenewStatus AutoRenewal
